chart.prompt: Select the best graph to visualize how the total deaths across Mistveil and Bluebell Woods break down by individual zones and causes.
chart.explanation: The pie chart shows the components of a single variable; the line chart shows trends over time; the bar chart shows the distribution of a dataset at a given time. We want to break total deaths down by zone and cause, so the pie chart is the most appropriate.
